title: AI-based 3D Measurement of Root Canal Curvature from CBCT: Validation of an Automated Schneider Angle Analysis
html: Conventional two-dimensional curvature assessment methods are insufficient to capture the complex three-dimensional (3D) geometry of root canals. This study aimed to develop and validate a deep learning–based pipeline for automated 3D Schneider angle measurement from cone-beam computed tomography images of mandibular molar mesial roots and to evaluate its agreement with expert manual measurements.
